caption: This is a bright, empty laboratory or workshop room filled with rows of wooden cabinetry. Light oak-veneer cabinets with white metal handles and drawer pulls line the space, each topped with a dark black countertop, and gray vented equipment boxes, a large cardboard box, and a black monitor sit on the counters while a white paper towel drapes over one edge. In the background a yellow flammable-storage cabinet marked with red lettering stands against a white wall near a metal sink faucet. The floor is pale off-white tile, and the whole room is evenly lit by bright overhead fluorescent ceiling panels.
